patch_description: Key changes vs the current program: (1) keep the fast global (non-hierarchical) replication + LPT packing pipeline that achieved the best GPU balancedness (0.76) and runtime; (2) replace the slow, ineffective single heavy↔lightest refinement loop with a vectorized top-K refinement: each round it evaluates the best swap between every (heavy GPU in top-K by load) × (all other GPUs) pair via a batched numpy computation, accepting the swap that minimizes the resulting max GPU load — directly attacking the GPU balancedness ceiling while staying O(rounds) in Python iterations; (3) use the correct marginal-gain greedy w/(c*(c+1)) for replication to improve expert-level balancedness; (4) cap refinement rounds (e.g. 3*num_phy) so runtime stays low.
